purpose: Define only the independently supported temporal boundary of the global distributed OTC FX market without inventing a single venue or universal weekly open/close timestamps.

authorities.source_title: The FX trade execution landscape through the prism of the 2025 BIS Triennial Survey
supports: FX spot and most FX derivatives transact over the counter
the global FX market is decentralized and fragmented
there is no single centralized exchange that represents the whole FX market
does_not_support: one provider schedule as global FX market truth
exact universal weekly open and close boundaries

authorities.organization: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Foreign Exchange Committee
supports: the FX market operates 24 hours a day
the global FX market is interconnected
does_not_support: a universal seven-day continuous trading claim

supports: foreign exchange markets form a complex network rather than a physical market
currencies can be bought and sold 24 hours a day
does_not_support: exact universal weekly open and close boundaries
provider schedule equivalence to canonical market hours
